notes.title: Regarding Some Recent Reviews
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I just wanted to take a moment to thank those of you who have played my game and shared constructive feedback, whether positive or negative.

This is a personal project I made with a lot of love, completely free to play, and I truly appreciate every honest opinion that helps me improve. That said, I’ve also been receiving some reviews filled with insults or complaints that completely ignore what the game clearly shows from the start (like the fact that it’s dark — which is shown in the tags, the trailer, and the screenshots).

I understand that not every game is for everyone, but I kindly ask for a bit of respect. If you don’t like something, tell me why — maybe I can learn from it. But pointless insults don’t help anyone.

Thank you again to everyone who shares their thoughts with respect and constructive intent. It’s because of people like you that I’ll keep creating.

notes.title: Online Records: Unknown Seller Launches on May 14, 2025
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=zhSZ_pQSBXM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]







 Hey everyone!

I’m incredibly excited to announce that Online Records: Unknown Seller will officially launch on May 14, 2025!

After a lot of hard work, tweaking, testing (and way too much coffee!), the game is finally ready to see the light of day. I want to take this moment to genuinely thank every single one of you who added the game to your wishlist. Your support has meant the world to me and has been a huge motivation throughout development.

There are still a few surprises coming before launch, so stay tuned!

See you on May 14th!

notes.title: Get Early Access to Online Records: Unknown Seller!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I hope you're doing well. First of all, I want to thank you for adding the game to your Steam wishlist. I'm very excited to introduce you to this new psychological horror game.

I'm here to announce that on the official Catire Games Studio website, we've opened a sign-up form to get early access to the game. If you want to try it before its official release, all you need to do is enter your email address in the registration form.

A few weeks before launch, we will send Steam keys to selected players. Spots are limited, so don’t miss this opportunity—sign up now!

Thank you for your support, and I wish you all the best!

https://www.catiregamesstudio.com/
